scope: Independent genuine-save GUI observations for three exact synthetic files; not a production parser contract. Publication is subject to separate dated exact owner approval.
content: Purpose-built empty native Sampler and its volume automation. No notes, sample files, imported audio, external plugins, personal projects or playback.

semantics.objects: Count independently observed saved native curve definitions, not occurrences.
semantics.points: Count editable main-curve nodes once per object; exclude hollow tension handles.
semantics.placements: GUI authoring control only; B03 has no visible nonempty rectangle and unqualified saved placement semantics, represented by null rather than zero.
semantics.zero: No explicit empty curve or general automation zero rule is established.

verification.sanitation: Remove only one event200 with 16-byte payload and two framing bytes, correcting FLdt length. Every retained event is byte-identical.
verification.privacy: Bounded Latin-1 and both UTF-16LE alignments; no known account/home/email, RIFF/image signature, nonempty sample filename or note payload. Opaque state is not exhaustively decoded.

cases.operation: Moved only the middle editable point vertically; original displayed -12.8dB, new -2.5dB, same 001:09:000 position.

Selected automation picker; painted second occurrence; used its explicit Make unique menu. Added two editable points only in #2. Reopened original settings and verified 2/2 ordinal with unchanged flat curve. No playback.
cases.savedTimingObservation: Second point of #2 displayed 001:05:000 before Save As and 001:05:001 after reopening both unchanged raw and sanitized files. Saved expectations use the latter actual observation; no byte-level timing decoder is qualified.

objects.name: Sampler - Channel volume
objects.placementObservation: Original Track1 occurrence no longer has a visible nonempty rectangle after deleting its final endpoint; no manual occurrence deletion. Saved placement semantics remain unqualified, do not equate this with an absent placement record.

cases.operation: Deleted middle point then second endpoint through native point menus. Point1/1 menu has Delete disabled; empty curve cannot be authored by this GUI path. Retained genuine one-point state for save/reopen.
cases.authoringLimitation: Final point Delete command disabled; explicit empty curve not achieved. Do not treat the absence of a visible nonempty rectangle as absent saved placement data.
